description: Distributor handles {:coverage_demand, tag}: pick node via coordinator service directory capabilities -> that node's Foreman starts materializer worker -> epoch lock/unlock (existing recovery machinery, single authority) -> TSL delta to Director (A4) -> {:covered, tag, pid} to placeholder. Backoff on failure; telemetry for demand/spin-up duration/park/shed counts. Read-version handoff: recruited materializer replays to current; version_too_old after long spin-up is acceptable client-retry.

comments.text: Note from q67.1: StorageRacing's rescue currently conflates 'uncovered shard' and 'key outside keyspace' into layout_lookup_failed. When wiring coverage demand, consider replacing the rescued raise with a structured {:error, {:uncovered_shard, tag, range}} so the placeholder/Distributor path gets the tag without re-lookup.

From q67.2 audit (wire when adding recruitment): (1) no retry when distributor start genuinely fails — Process.send_after retry; (2) no backoff on re-recruit — crash-looping distributor restarts at full speed; (3) log older-epoch notify_epoch_change as suspicious; (4) consider skipping re-recruit on DOWN reason == :normal once epoch notification is wired (stale-epoch re-recruit is currently self-limiting but wasteful).

From q67.4 audit: consider link-side epoch stamping/compare on {:tsl_updated, tsl} — a not-quite-dead old leader could overwrite a newer TSL after a link switches coordinators (nil-clear makes naive guarding tricky). Director.apply_tsl_delta/3 contract confirmed: exact-epoch, :unavailable pre-recovery, atomic apply+handoff.

From PR #91 second-pass audit: (1) tighten already_started adoption — Shared.starter_for maps {:error,{:already_started,pid}} to {:ok,pid}, so a new-epoch director can adopt a stale distributor; call check_epoch after adoption and re-recruit if superseded. (2) Do not assume strict cluster-wide singleton-ness during epoch transitions (different-node directors can briefly yield two live distributors; epoch guard fences mutations). (3) Add re-recruitment backoff when real workload lands.

Implemented in PR #95 (feature/q67-recruitment, base feature/q67-placeholder, merges feature/q67-tsl-delta). Audit items done except the structured {:error, {:uncovered_shard, tag, range}} from StorageRacing: lookup_key! has no tag available and the failure-map shape ripples through PointReads/RangeReads callers; with placeholders filling every slot the {_range, []} branch no longer occurs, so the raise stays as a backstop. Deferred as follow-up.
